acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of exterior house painting depends on several factors, including the size and condition of your home, the type of paint chosen, and the amount of preparation required. Factors like lead paint abatement or extensive repairs to siding can also impact the final price. We provide customized quotes after a thorough on-site evaluation to ensure accuracy.
acceptedAnswer.description: Exterior painting costs vary based on house size, condition, paint type, and necessary prep work.
